gloss: minding the shop; person minding a shop

definitions.gloss: minding the shop; person minding a shop
definitions.explanation: Looking after a small shop and serving customers, often while the owner is away; also the person who does it. Usual with する: {店番|みせばん}をする.

examples.japanese: {店番|みせばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{店番|みせばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother is minding the shop.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{配達|はいたつ}→配達：00084_haitatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}ている→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧、⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{店番|みせばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}まれた→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧。
examples.english: While my father was out on deliveries, I was asked to mind the shop.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧⟦{本屋|ほんや}→本屋：03034_honya⟧で、⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦レジ→レジ：00879_reji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{横|よこ}→横：02984_yoko⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{店番|みせばん}⟦のように→のように：30291_noyouni⟧⟦{座|すわ}っていた→座る：00757_suwaru⟧。
examples.english: In a little bookshop, a cat sat by the till as if it were minding the shop.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧ (shop) and ⟦{番|ばん}→番：09873_ban⟧ (watch, turn). Used of small family-run shops more than of large stores, where staff are ⟦{店員|てんいん}→店員：00897_tenin⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {店番|みせばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to mind the shop
- {店番|みせばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}む→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧: to ask someone to mind the shop
- {店番|みせばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{任|まか}せる→任せる：02417_makaseru⟧: to leave someone in charge of the shop

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{留守番|るすばん}→留守番：15546_rusuban⟧: looking after the house while others are out
- ⟦{店員|てんいん}→店員：00897_tenin⟧: shop assistant — a paid employee
